text: Is the new SIMATIC S7‑1200 G2 controller generation compatible with previous SIMATIC S7‑1200 modules?

The new SIMATIC S7‑1200 G2 controller generation is not hardware‑compatible with the previous SIMATIC S7‑1200 family. While existing SIMATIC S7‑1200 PLC programs can typically be converted for SIMATIC S7‑1200 G2 with only minor adjustments, hardware compatibility must be checked in advance.
